items.title: Is Synopsys (SNPS) A Bargain Following Its European Chip Design Platform Deal?
items.summary: Synopsys (SNPS) just struck an agreement with the European Chips Joint Undertaking to feed its design software into the new European Chips Design Platform, opening institutional access for younger semiconductor outfits. Against that backdrop, Synopsys shares trade at US$462.69, with a 7 day share price return of 5.1% and a 90 day share price return of 9.8%, pointing to firming momentum even though the 30 day share price return declined 6.4% and the year to date share price return is down...

items.title: Synopsys (SNPS) Joins European Chips Design Platform For Startups And Mid Sized Firms
items.summary: Synopsys (NasdaqGS:SNPS) has entered an agreement with the European Chips Joint Undertaking to support the European Chips Design Platform. The collaboration targets startups and medium-sized semiconductor firms that need access to advanced electronic design automation tools for chip development. The program is intended to back work on AI, high-performance computing and photonics within the European semiconductor ecosystem. items.title: Nvidia CEO Huang resigns amid affair scandals, board names CFO Colette Kress interim CEO
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is resigning following reports that he had an affair with a fellow executive at the AI giant and after he admitted to having a separate affair with a woman who US intelligence officials believe is a Chinese spy.
